acceptanceCriteria: Owner decision on reporter ordering recorded; a proposed PWP spec amendment defines the qualification command, its receipt (kept reporters, host tuple) and how a qualified keep-reporters receipt projects.
After acceptance: implementation with focused tests, a live qualification on a supported tuple, adopter documentation, sealed change evidence; GitHub #686 closed by the merged PR.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#686, follow-up to #670 (V1-0986, PWP-V0-010..013) on main-ecfff8e. --keep-reporters receipts project non-passing until a live keep-reporters qualification is recorded, but no command or documented procedure records one, so adopters that need a project reporter keep getting corvint_test_validity abstentions. Asks: (1) a command to run and record a live keep-reporters qualification on the adopter's host/tuple (like the Node 24 / Playwright 1.63 qualification from #665), naming the kept reporters; (2) owner decision on the open spec question whether the provider reporter runs first; (3) document the adopter steps (qualify, then pass --keep-reporters) in the provider spec. Related: V1-1002 (live qualification of --keep-reporters before keep receipts pass).
